title: Dattri-llm wrap-up board
blurb: Hub-local tracker for TRAIS-Lab/dattri-llm wrap-up. Never create GitHub issues from this board. Round-2 dual-LGTM (Opus + Astra) applied at tip a5c08fc; live board.json is landed by Manage Bot from board.proposed.json drafts only. Round-3 paper-consistency dual-LGTM (r3-paper) applied at the same tip: 13 agreed items on H6/H8/new H9. Round-4 library-readability dual-LGTM (r4-readability) at tip 7f967a5 (dev): 13 agreed items on new H10–H14.

openIssues.author: TonyZhou05
openIssues.title: Pin the lint toolchain outside CI (ruff version, dev extra, pre-commit)
openIssues.notes: Round-4 library-readability dual-YES (Opus + Astra, tip 7f967a5; blind gate real + industry_norm + not_taste). R4-1 [lint-format, med/S] — ruff==0.15.20 is pinned only in lint.yml:35; the dev extra (pyproject.toml:35-42) has no ruff, Makefile:11 runs an unpinned ruff on narrower paths, there is no pre-commit, and CLAUDE.md:85-86 wrongly says CI runs `make check`. Latest ruff 0.16.9 reports 115 errors (RUF105/RUF201) where 0.15.20 is clean. Fix: add ruff==0.15.20 to the dev extra, set [tool.ruff] required-version = "==0.15.20", add .pre-commit-config.yaml (astral-sh/ruff-pre-commit v0.15.20, ruff + ruff-format), align `make check` with CI's `ruff check .` / `ruff format --check .`, and correct CLAUDE.md. Splits not landed: R4-10 (layer_name→layer_names), R4-13 (module size/complexity scoping), R4-14 (utils module_kwargs exports) — see merged-dual-lgtm-round4.md. Hub-local only; never a TRAIS-Lab issue.
